title: Layer 5: Wild Signals
title_zh: 第五层：草蛇灰线——意外信号
desc: Grassroots clues — more reliable than headlines
desc_zh: 这些不在头条里，但比任何高级指标都准

mbsItinerary.threshold: More Beijing than DC visits = strategic drift
mbsItinerary.threshold_zh: 去北京多于华盛顿=战略偏移
mbsItinerary.note: MBS declined Evian meeting with France (Jun 12). Trump calls MBS a 'warrior'. Saudi Cabinet chaired by MBS welcomed original US-Iran agreement (Jun 17). Now with collapsed ceasefire, Saudi facing direct security threat (Iranian drones targeted Bahrain). MBS lifted Lebanon ban (Jun 11). Hosted Sudan's Burhan in Jeddah (Apr). No new foreign trip reported. Hajj 2026 ongoing — potential security concerns. Updated 2026-06-28
mbsItinerary.note_zh: MBS拒绝与法国在埃维昂会晤（6月12日）。特朗普称MBS为'战士'。MBS主持内阁欢迎美伊初步协议（6月17日）。现停火崩溃，沙特面临直接安全威胁（伊朗无人机攻击巴林）。MBS解除黎巴嫩禁令（6月11日）。吉达接待苏丹布尔汉（4月）。无新外访行程。2026年朝觐进行中——潜在安全担忧。更新于 2026-06-28

singaporeStance.value: Officially neutral, adjusting quietly — AI hub role growing
singaporeStance.value_zh: 官方中立，暗中调整——AI枢纽角色增长
singaporeStance.threshold: Singapore picks a side = every other Asian ally is already doing it
singaporeStance.threshold_zh: 新加坡选边=其他亚洲盟友已经在做了
singaporeStance.note: Both US and Chinese AI firms setting up shop in Singapore as 'Asia's neutral AI hub' (Fortune, Jun 19). 'Washington Is Testing Singapore's Patience' (Foreign Policy, Jun 5). No policy stance shift yet. Michael Baumgartner visits Singapore amid US-China competition (Jun 3). Quad launches Indo-Pacific monitor plan (May). Updated 2026-06-28
singaporeStance.note_zh: 中美AI企业均在狮城设点，新加坡成为'亚洲中立AI枢纽'（财富，6月19日）。'华盛顿在考验新加坡的耐心'（外交政策，6月5日）。政策立场未变。美议员访问新加坡。四方机制启动印太监测计划（5月）。更新于 2026-06-28

adbLoanCurrency.threshold: Meaningful increase (>2%) = multilateral acceptance of RMB
adbLoanCurrency.threshold_zh: 显著增长(>2%)=多边机构对RMB的实质接受
adbLoanCurrency.note: ADB annual report expected late June. EU Trade Chief to meet China's Commerce Minister in Brussels Jun 29 — trade finance implications. No new ADB data found this cycle. Updated 2026-06-28
adbLoanCurrency.note_zh: 亚行年报预计6月底发布。欧盟贸易代表6月29日与中商务部长在布鲁塞尔会晤——贸易金融影响。本周期未发现亚行新数据。更新于 2026-06-28

hkmaInterventions.threshold: Sustained weak-side touches = capital outflow pressure from Asia
hkmaInterventions.threshold_zh: 持续触碰弱方=亚洲资本外流压力
hkmaInterventions.note: No major HKMA intervention reported this week. However, with US-Iran military escalation, capital flight from Gulf/MENA to safe havens may affect HKD peg. Monitor for weak-side touches. Updated 2026-06-28
hkmaInterventions.note_zh: 本周未报告金管局重大干预。但美伊军事升级可能导致海湾/中东资本逃向避险资产，影响港币联系汇率。关注弱方兑换触发。更新于 2026-06-28

chinaGoldImportPath.value: Hong Kong/Dubai route surging; direct Russia unclear
chinaGoldImportPath.value_zh: 香港/迪拜路线激增；对俄直购不明
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold: Route change = settlement system de-dollarization in motion
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold_zh: 路径改变=结算体系去美元化在进行
chinaGoldImportPath.note: China's gold imports rise to highest in more than 2 years, up 76% YTD (Seeking Alpha, Jun 24). 'Gold rush: Hong Kong bullion imports from Dubai jump amid US-Iran war' (SCMP, May 4) — suggesting route shift via Dubai/Hong Kong, not direct Russia. Russia sold 22 tonnes of gold this year (KITCO, Apr 21). 'Gold's center of gravity has moved East' (GoldSilver, May 21). No confirmed direct Russia route data. Updated 2026-06-28
chinaGoldImportPath.note_zh: 中国黄金进口创两年多新高，YTD增长76%（Seeking Alpha，6月24日）。'黄金热潮：美伊战争下香港从迪拜的黄金进口激增'（南华早报，5月4日）——表明路径经迪拜/香港而非直接对俄。俄罗斯今年售出22吨黄金（KITCO，4月21日）。'黄金重心已东移'（GoldSilver，5月21日）。无确认的对俄直购路径数据。更新于 2026-06-28

pewFavorability.value_zh: 美国约49% · 中国约36%（2025年，25国中位数）
pewFavorability.threshold: US declining across allies; China stable-low but improving in Global South
pewFavorability.threshold_zh: 美国在盟友中好感度持续下降；中国稳定偏低但在全球南方改善
pewFavorability.note: Pew surveyed 35 countries in 2024 and 25 in spring 2025. US median favorable fell from 54% to ~49%. China rose from 35% to ~36%.
pewFavorability.note_zh: 皮尤2024年调查35国、2025年春季调查25国。美国好感度中位数从54%降至约49%。中国从35%升至约36%。
